entities.name: St Nicholas Church Wismar
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Nicholas of Wismar was built from 1381 until 1487 as a church for sailors and fishermen. Nicholas is one of the finest testaments to medieval brick architecture in northern Germany.
